facts.says: Google Play genre ENTERTAINMENT; title YouTube Kids; summary: An app made just for kids

YouTube Kids is an American video app and website developed by YouTube, a subsidiary of Google. The app provides a version of the service oriented solely towards children, with curated selections of content, parental control features, and filtering of videos deemed inappropriate for viewing by child
